native_facts: 各芯片每层保留原布局的 22 个专家、额外调入 2 个专家，两套布局共用原权重。全 40 层额外权重和 scale 为每芯片 2,705.94 MiB。在逐 rank 核对格式 29 后，816、817、834 行的 120 个原生调用计入设备 ID 重排，按轮相加的配对中位节省 29.18 ms，12/12 轮均节省。416 行只赢 5/12 轮，保持原路径。M3 用逐专家列表传原权重时，五个用例的延迟比中位数上升 2.25%，因此保留原单张量 decode 图。
service_decision: 真实权重的两轮诊断共核对 8,080,588,800 个 BF16 输出和 46,080 个逻辑专家计数，均一致。已完成的 5 轮 C8 有 40 份输出与归档一致。实际 20 次跨 40 层的 prefill 中有 7 次命中。baseline-3 的 4 次均未命中，触发每轮至少命中一次的预定停止条件。未形成三组计时，首 token 与整轮收益均未知。

shape_coverage.unit: One EP16-wide target eager invocation spanning 40 layers; count once regardless of layer count or 16 reporting ranks. Historical sources and different service modes are separately labeled. No claim of a deployment probability.

joint_traffic.method: Same logical route, top-six order, source rank and source-card reducer capacity. Reconstruct each physical expert slot after the exact two-extra map. Verified all 384 remapped counters at each guarded call. Scan each source row once and reuse the existing ordered reduction solver. The unselected M416 reuses its original result. Logical traffic; no per-byte latency conversion or independent addition of branches.
